bullets: The Solar Pro 4 model is now free as a limited-time promotion and moved to the Unlimited section.
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Fast is now visible in the model picker for users with full access.
The model picker now groups options into three sections: Unlimited, Optimized, and Powerful.
The first daily coding session discount has been removed.
A clear, non-dismissible warning now appears on the CLI launch panel if your subscription payment fails.
Space Bunny Alpha no longer displays a Recommended label in the model picker.
The fast variant of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash now requires a paid subscription for users in restricted regions.
Two background file-finding tasks now run on the GPT-6 Luna model.
The terminal program now saves a backup of its screen engine to a private folder if temporary storage is blocked.
The terminal program now provides clear instructions to fix temporary storage issues instead of crashing.
The terminal program now gives clear error messages when command results fail to save due to full or inaccessible storage.
The developer kit now stops immediately when a server reports a session was superseded, instead of retrying.
Background file-finding tasks no longer incorrectly select the wrong sub-agent during their final report.
The billboard ad placement now has a limit of 5 impressions per day, per campaign, and per user.
